Name: Toothless Sounds
Author: 0Logophile0
Description:
[font=Tahoma][size=4][color=#1155cc]
[/color]This is a simple [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ mod that changes your pet cat's sounds so they make grumbly, growly, dragon-y noises that sound like Toothless from [i]How to Train Your Dragon.[/i]

While originally made to complement ObscureCat's fabulous [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15448]Stardew Toothless[/url]﻿, this mod can be used on its own if you just want to have a cat that grumbles, growls, or mrrrwwolllls.

!!! NEWLY ADDED COMPATIBILITY FOR [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35306?a]Custom Toothless Pet[/url]﻿ by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/strawhatwem?gameId=1303]strawhatwem[/url]﻿ - definitely grab this for a total Toothless experience!

Randomly plays one of three different sounds.


[color=red][b][u]REQUIREMENTS:[/u][/b][/color][/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Tahoma][size=4][url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size][/font]
[/list][font=Tahoma][size=4]

[b]INSTALL:[/b][/size]
[/font][list=1]
[*][font=Tahoma][size=4]Download & install required mods into ﻿Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Tahoma][size=4]Unzip this mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Tahoma][size=4]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Tahoma]

[/font][color=#f1f1f1][font=Tahoma][size=4]SEE ALSO:[/size]
[/font][list]

[/list][/color]

Downloads.Description:
Added a new configuration option to enable/disable the pet cat sounds.

**For those using Custom Toothless Pet - if you don't want your pet cat to also mrowwly grumble, set the config option to "false" or disable via GMCM.**

Manifest.Description: Changes pet cat's sounds to Toothless' mrwowls
